newsitem.title: ZAMBIA: Former ZCCM boss to head its privatisation.
newsitem.headline: Former ZCCM boss to head its privatisation.

text.p: Zambian president Frederick Chiluba on Wednesday appointed former Zambia Consolidated Copper Mines (ZCCM) chairman and chief executive Francis Kaunda as chairman of the ZCCM privatisation negotiating team.
"The appointment of Mr. Kaunda will enhance the negotiating capacity of ZCCM so that the country obtains full benefits from the privatisation programme," a State House spokesman said.
Chiluba said in his appointment letter that Kaunda's knowledge of the assets of the company would help protect the interests of Zambians.
"This will be achieved by enabling both ZCCM and the Zambia Privatisation Agency to have the benefit of your advice as they pass the necessary resolutions to effect privatisation," the letter said.
Kaunda takes over from Joseph Phiri, who recently died.
